what: P1-E7d dose-response: behaviour, coupling and representation at six doses through a benign fine-tuning run, both arms.
headline: COUPLING COLLAPSES BEFORE BEHAVIOUR DOES. In the benign arm the steerable-layer count goes 13 -> 0 by step 100 (400 examples) while refusal still retains ~81% of its dose-0 value. The prediction was that the two would fall TOGETHER; they do not. The coupling is destroyed almost immediately and the refusal that survives is produced by a pathway the direction never mediated.
falsifier_did_not_fire: Probe (logistic) = 1.000 at EVERY dose in BOTH arms; mass-mean 0.981-1.000. The harmfulness representation is untouched at every point on the curve. The capability account predicted it would degrade with the behaviour.
register_shift: The substring curve is NON-MONOTONIC in the benign arm (0.682 -> 0.773 at dose 250), which is the register-shift artifact the script's docstring predicted BEFORE the run. Adding the normative refusals the regex cannot match gives a smooth curve: 0.985 -> 0.803 -> 0.811 -> 0.576 -> 0.591 -> 0.492. The endpoint 0.492 lands on the WildGuard-audited 0.477 of the original attacked checkpoint, by an independent route.

normative_share_of_surviving_refusals.benign: 0% at dose 0, then 15/5/30/68/63% -- rises as coupling stays at zero
normative_share_of_surviving_refusals.safety-preserved: 0-1% at every dose -- coupling never collapses, register never shifts
normative_share_of_surviving_refusals.reading: Where the coupling survives, refusal stays first-person canonical. Where it is destroyed, the surviving refusal shifts to a normative register. The direction mediates a REGISTER, and this is that claim with a time axis.

seed_replication: dose 1500 is an independent training run from the 2026-09-19 attacked checkpoint (that one died with its pod). Substring refusal 0.182 here against 0.189 there, l* = -1 in both, zero steerable layers in both, max induce -5.170 against -5.188. The endpoint replicates at a different LoRA draw.

BLOCKING_control.name: transplant the dose-0 direction into a later dose
BLOCKING_control.why: The direction is RE-FITTED from each dose's own activations, so 'no valid direction at dose 100' has two readings: the coupling is destroyed, or the mean-diff estimator no longer FINDS a direction that still works. These are different claims and the curve cannot separate them.
BLOCKING_control.how: The LoRA adapters are saved at every dose (models/olmo2_e7d-{arm}-adapter-{step}). Inject the dose-0 direction into the dose-100 model: if it induces refusal, the coupling survived and the estimator lost it; if it does not, the coupling is gone. Same logic as P1-E7b's rlvr->attacked cell, which DID restore refusal at +1.069.
